promises.label: FY27 revenue growth guidance constant currency
promises.quote: Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year-on-year in constant currency terms.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: FY27 operating margin guidance
promises.quote: Our operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: At least 20,000 freshers to be hired
promises.quote: This year also, we are expecting at least 20,000 freshers to be hired.
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Stratus acquisition ~25 bps baked into guidance
promises.quote: What is baked into the guidance is approximately 25 basis points or a quarter point of the guidance.
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Acquisition-related cost headwind 60-70 bps
promises.quote: The acquisition related cost will impact margins by another 60 to 70 basis points.
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Client headwind wind down baked into guidance
promises.quote: certain headwinds from a particular client which will wind down towards the end of the year. That is baked in in the guidance
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

reported.label: FY26 constant currency growth 3.1%
reported.quote: We had growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms.

reported.label: Q4 YoY constant currency growth 4.1%
reported.quote: On Q4, our growth year-on-year was 4.1% in constant currency terms.

reported.label: FY26 large deals $14.9 bn, up 28%
reported.quote: Large deals were very good, $14.9 bn for the full year, $3.2 bn for the fourth quarter. The full year was 28% higher than it was in the previous year.

reported.label: FY26 operating margin 21%
reported.quote: the full year margins is at 21%. The quarterly margins also 20.9%

reported.label: FY26 net new large deals 55%
reported.quote: the net new is pretty large for the full year at 55%

reported.label: Hired more than 20,000 freshers in FY26
reported.quote: we had announced 20,000 for FY26 and we have hired more than 20,000 freshers from the market.

reported.label: Headcount up 5,000 YoY, down 8,000 QoQ
reported.quote: our headcount sequentially has gone down by 8,000 employees but if you look at on a year-on-year basis it has still grown by 5,000.
